city.mottoEn: Good habits matter more than good fortune.
city.coreVision: Technology is only an enabler. Good habits create lasting success. Programming helps children cultivate positive thinking, discipline, creativity, perseverance, compassion, and responsibility.

threeLoves.focus: Positive thinking, daily discipline, calm debugging, and lifelong curiosity.
Compassion, teamwork, listening carefully, and building helpful tools for neighbors.
Responsibility, ecological stewardship, clean water, renewable energy, and living forests.

districts.description: Every adventure starts at the carved cedar Welcome Plaza, where students step off daily autopilot beside rainwater fountains and shaded bike lanes.
High above the mist stands the brass observatory atop Function Mountain, organizing small repeatable helper routines that feed clear water downstream.
Botanical boardwalks and brass lenses invite learners to ask bold questions, trace how ecosystems connect, and document every discovery clearly.
Crafted beside the Bamboo Waterwheel, ridge-top wind turbines and tiled solar eaves transform natural sunlight and river flow into clean city power.

districts.nameZh: 大地花園 · 梯田育苗園
districts.description: Stepped contour seedling beds fed by bamboo flumes store every monsoon drop carefully before returning clear water to the watershed below.
Solar-roofed timber cottages linked by shaded bicycle lanes where citizens learn how clear names keep household supplies and code dependable.
An S-curve waterway filtered by river reeds and stone shoals that teaches students how thoughtful repetition keeps both creeks and skills pure.
Neighborly verandas where Little Ci care-bots help children water roses for elders and deliver warm tea without replacing human kindness.
Open cedar studios overlooking the bamboo gorge where programming serves strictly as an enabler for empathy, honesty, and practical wisdom.
River telemetry bells and type-classification workbenches help young detectives measure rainfall accurately instead of guessing blindly.
Quiet branching woodland trails under tall pines where learners trace conditions step by step to choose the safest, kindest fork.
Beneath a flowering moss-and-fern living roof, families sort paper, glass, compost, metal, and timber so nothing helpful ever becomes trash.
A sunlit timber studio where students blend time delays, storytelling input, and hand sketches to prototype helpful inventions for neighbors.
Rising above clean water channels before the central Bio-Canopy, this living cedar pagoda unites solar eave craft with humane AI stewardship.

districts.nameZh: 慶典大廳 · 迎向未來
districts.description: Across twin bridges over the blooming pink lotus pond, every completed lesson illuminates a celebratory lantern that brightens all of Kindness City.

chapters.title: Chapter I · Stepping Through the Gate
chapters.subtitle: Foundations, Voice & Intentional Craft
chapters.districtLabel: Welcome Plaza · Coding Academy · Curiosity Park
chapters.summary: Begin the adventure by speaking clearly to the computer and organizing clean, respectful habits before writing larger programs.

lessons.title: Python + print()
lessons.pythonConcept: print() output strings and greeting messages
lessons.positiveHabit: Positive Thinking: Speak encouraging words to yourself and others at the start of every task.

lessons.title: Coding Environment + Function + Comment
lessons.pythonConcept: Workspace setup, starter functions, and # comments
lessons.positiveHabit: Discipline: Keep tools neat and leave thoughtful explanations so teammates can follow easily.

chapters.title: Chapter II · Naming & Observing Our World
chapters.subtitle: Memory Containers, Measurements & Truthful Types
chapters.districtLabel: Variable Village · Earth Garden · Data District
chapters.summary: Learn how clean variable names and accurate data types mirror caring stewardship across nurseries, rainfall basins, and stream gauges.

lessons.title: Variable
lessons.positiveHabit: Orderliness: Label what matters clearly so nothing gets lost or wasted.

lessons.title: Variable Practice
lessons.pythonConcept: Updating variables as saplings and water levels change
lessons.positiveHabit: Patient Stewardship: Notice small daily growth in gardens and good routines.

lessons.title: Data Types
lessons.positiveHabit: Honest Observation: Measure the world accurately before jumping to conclusions.

lessons.title: Data Type Detective
lessons.pythonConcept: Inspecting and converting mismatched data with type()
lessons.positiveHabit: Curiosity & Problem-Solving: Investigate errors calmly instead of giving up.

chapters.title: Chapter III · Clear Arithmetic & Kind Choices
chapters.subtitle: Comparing Facts, Sorting Streams & Branching Wisely
chapters.districtLabel: Data District · Logic Forest · Recycling Center
chapters.summary: Pair mathematical balance and boolean fairness with real-world decisions that protect streams, wildlife, and zero-waste sorting stations.

lessons.title: Arithmetic Operators
lessons.pythonConcept: Addition, subtraction, division, and remainder helpers
lessons.positiveHabit: Fair Sharing: Balance solar energy and rainwater evenly across every terrace.

lessons.title: Comparison Operators
lessons.positiveHabit: Fairness: Check facts objectively rather than judging by rumors.

lessons.title: Comparison + Boolean
lessons.pythonConcept: Combining True/False logic with and, or, not
lessons.positiveHabit: Thoughtful Judgment: Look at both need and impact before taking action.

lessons.title: If
lessons.pythonConcept: Triggering protective actions when a condition holds
lessons.positiveHabit: Proactive Helpfulness: Step in kindly whenever you spot a classmate in need.

lessons.title: If / Else
lessons.positiveHabit: Responsibility: Sort every resource thoughtfully under the living moss roof.

chapters.title: Chapter IV · Rivers, Rhythm & Shared Lists
chapters.subtitle: Repetition With Purpose, Pacing & Community Care
chapters.districtLabel: Loop River · Friendship Square · Earth Garden
chapters.summary: Let loops and lists carry steady kindness down the Loop River, pairing patience and unhurried timing with team care routines.

lessons.title: For Loop
lessons.pythonConcept: Repeating predictable steps across a counted range
lessons.positiveHabit: Steady Consistency: Good habits practiced daily outshine rare bursts of effort.

lessons.title: For Loop Challenge + time.sleep()
lessons.pythonConcept: Controlling rhythm, reflection pauses, and timed steps
lessons.positiveHabit: Patience & Mindfulness: Pause and breathe calmly between big steps.

lessons.title: List
lessons.pythonConcept: Gathering items, neighbors, and supplies in ordered lists
lessons.positiveHabit: Inclusiveness: Make sure no friend, elder, or sapling is left off the list.

lessons.title: List + For Loop
lessons.pythonConcept: Visiting every element in a list systematically
lessons.positiveHabit: Compassion in Action: Check on every neighbor along the garden path one by one.

chapters.title: Chapter V · Perseverance, Listening & Kind AI
chapters.subtitle: While Goals, Human Dialogue & Ethical Innovation
chapters.districtLabel: Function Mountain · Innovation Tower · Celebration Hall
chapters.summary: Combine persistent while loops, attentive human input, and humane Python AI projects that serve people and protect the Earth.

lessons.title: While Loop
lessons.pythonConcept: Condition-driven persistence until a clean milestone finishes
lessons.positiveHabit: Perseverance: Keep gently trying and refining until your goal is reached.

lessons.title: While Loop Challenge
lessons.pythonConcept: Preventing infinite loops and debugging guard conditions
lessons.positiveHabit: Self-Reflection: Check your own habits when stuck instead of blaming others.

lessons.title: Input + Interactive Program
lessons.pythonConcept: Listening to user input() and answering thoughtfully
lessons.positiveHabit: Empathy & Listening: Ask first and listen closely before trying to help.

lessons.title: Python AI Challenge
lessons.positiveHabit: Responsible Problem-Solving: Always steer technology to love self, others, and the Earth.
